title: AI Security Engineer (f/m/d)
locationText: Berlin or Hamburg, Remote within Germany, Cape Town, UK, or Serbia
description:
Clariness is looking for an AI Security Engineer (f/m/d) based Germany, UK, SA, or Serbia.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

This role is about building, operating and continuously improving Clariness’ security capabilities across applications, cloud infrastructure and AI systems. As our founding-level security hire, you will establish the security engineering function, define its priorities and work directly with engineering teams to embed effective security controls throughout our technology environment.

As an AI Security Engineer, you would be responsible for:

• Defining Clariness’ security engineering strategy and roadmap, and building and operating the security function across application security, cloud security, AI and LLM security, vulnerability management and supporting security tooling.

• Working directly with engineering teams on secure system design, threat modelling, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation, while embedding appropriate security controls into development processes and CI/CD pipelines.

• Owning AI security and governance across LLM-powered features, RAG systems and agentic pipelines, including assessing and mitigating risks covered by the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

• Designing and validating safeguards for AI agents, including sandboxing, privilege and access controls, secure tool use and adversarial red teaming of AI systems.

• Evaluating, deploying and continuously improving AI-powered security automation, including autonomous vulnerability triage, LLM-powered alert analysis, compliance evidence gathering and AI-assisted threat intelligence.

• Assessing commercial and open-source security tools based on effectiveness, operational fit and cost, and developing custom solutions where existing tooling does not meet Clariness’ requirements.

• Managing Clariness’ IT security compliance programme-including SOC 2 Type II, applicable EU AI Act high-risk obligations, GDPR Article 32 technical measures and GxP IT security controls-while maintaining audit-ready documentation and acting as the primary security liaison for external auditors, regulators, Legal and Compliance.

We would like you to have: 

• At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or information security, with strong technical depth beyond advisory or governance responsibilities.

• Proven experience building or significantly developing a security programme within a product engineering environment, ideally as an early or founding security hire.

• Strong practical experience across application security, cloud security, secure software development, threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security controls within CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience assessing, testing or implementing security controls for LLM-powered applications, RAG systems or agentic pipelines.

• Hands-on experience with AI agents, either building them for security automation or securing them through adversarial testing, sandboxing and privilege controls.

• Demonstrable compliance experience involving at least one SOC 2 audit cycle, GDPR programme ownership or implementation of EU AI Act requirements, including the ability to produce audit-ready documentation and work with external auditors.

• Experience in a regulated industry such as clinical research, pharmaceuticals, healthtech or fintech, with knowledge of GxP or comparable regulated data-handling requirements considered a strong advantage, alongside strong English communication skills at C1 level.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons - and you'll learn more during the process.

• A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.

• Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.

• Flexible working hours and mobile working.

• Regular team events

title: Social Media & Brand Executive
description:
Social Media & Brand Executive
Dynime is seeking a creative, strategic, and trend-aware Social Media & Brand Executive to enhance its global brand presence across digital platforms. This role involves planning, creating, publishing, and optimizing content to build brand awareness, engage the audience, and support business growth.
You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Design, Content, Video, Sales, and Leadership teams to develop compelling campaigns, maintain brand consistency, and expand Dynime's presence on platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok.

Responsibilities

• Brand Management: Maintain consistent brand messaging and visual identity, ensure content aligns with brand guidelines, support brand positioning, and collaborate on campaigns.

• Community Engagement: Respond to inquiries, build relationships with followers and professionals, monitor brand mentions, and encourage discussions.

• Campaign Management: Execute product launches and promotional campaigns, coordinate with performance marketing, and support events.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media Studies, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 2-5+ years of experience managing professional social media accounts.

• Excellent English writing and communication skills.

• Strong understanding of social media algorithms and best practices.

• Experience creating engaging content for B2B audiences.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with SaaS, AI, software development, technology companies, or digital agencies.

• Experience with LinkedIn thought leadership campaigns.

• Basic graphic design knowledge (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).

• Familiarity with short-form video content strategies.

• Understanding of paid social advertising.

• Knowledge of employer branding and corporate communications.

Tools You'll Use
LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite, X (Twitter), YouTube Studio, TikTok Business Center, Canva, Adobe Photoshop (Basic), Adobe Illustrator (Basic), Figma, Buffer, Hootsuite, Metricool, Google Workspace, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), AI-powered content and productivity tools.

title: Physical Product Planning Intern (all genders)
description:
Your role

We are looking for a physical product planning working student for 12 months at the heart of our Product team, where you will be responsible for supporting our operational and strategic needs for our physical product: meal kits. You will be central to our activity and will have a significant influence on our customers' meals.

We are looking for someone capable of assisting us in the operational planning of recipes at HelloFresh. This is a unique opportunity to learn and gain experience within a fast-growing company that is pioneering the food industry.

If you want to be a driving force in the growth of a scale-up, then this position is for you!

 

Your area of responsibility

• Menu creation and optimization: Assist the team in creating and optimizing menus using our python-based menu-planning algorithm.

• Product Improvement: You will work on several projects and initiatives that focus on improving our product offering aiming to increase customer satisfaction.

• Menu De-Risking: You will lead a number of cross-collaborative initiatives and processes aiming to reduce the menu risk and to ensure ingredient availability by considering the end-to-end value chain of our product. 

• Operations support: You support the team in day-to-day operations as well as with administrative and organizational tasks along the supply and menu planning process and have the opportunity to solve concrete problems, make decisions, and learn to manage real-world situations in a dynamic environment.

• Process management: You will participate in projects aimed at optimizing and automating and improving our product processes and supply chain by working with other teams.

• Reporting: You will track the weekly performance of menus and recipes, and conduct analyses on their monthly/quarterly performance.

• Recipe change management in menus: You will select alternative recipes when needed (ingredient shortage, marketing need, etc.).

• Recipe & Ingredient Pool management: You will contribute to the maintenance of the recipe and ingredient database in alignment with the culinary teams.

• Customization: You will support the expansion of our product offering by uploading and managing customized menu options to provide customers with greater choice.

 

Your profile

• You are completing a degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline, ideally with a focus on Product Management, Supply Chain or Operations Management.

• Initial experience in product management or supply planning, CPG and E-Commerce experience is a plus.

• Excellent command of Excel; knowledge of SQL and Python is a real plus.

• A hands-on mindset and team spirit, which is very important as you will be working with many different people and teams.

• Fluency in English, German is a plus.

• Strong organizational skills, rigor, and great attention to detail.

• A proactive and ambitious mindset, with a desire to be part of a particularly dynamic business.

• Enthusiasm for the world of food and an interest in data are real assets for this job.

 

What we offer you

 

• Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg

• Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products

• Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program

• Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.

• Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners, as well as yoga classes

• Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill

• Monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket

description:
INVESTOR RELATIONS AI RESEARCHER

(Results Decks, Board Packs)

Full time | Remote - India

ABOUT US

Aptura is a London-based company working on understanding how AI is changing professional work. We look closely at how finance and advisory professionals actually work, and where AI helps or falls short. The company was founded by people with backgrounds at Lazard, McKinsey and Partners Group.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

We are looking for Subject Matter Experts from investor relations or FP&A who own the quarterly cycle of results decks, board packs and KPI reporting. You know that rolling a deck forward is never just swapping numbers.

You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make, or you simply want to find out how good they really are.

You will turn that experience into realistic PowerPoint tasks that test how well AI do the deck work of an IR or FP&A analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

- Writing realistic PowerPoint tasks drawn from your own reporting cycle: building decks from source documents, filling corporate templates, rolling decks forward and making precise edits

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing a yes-or-no checklist precise enough that an AI grader can mark any attempt against it

NECESSARY SKILLS INCLUDE

- 3+ years in investor relations, FP&A or financial reporting at a listed company or large corporate

- Deep hands-on PowerPoint: native charts, tables and corporate templates

- Ability to define what a correct deck looks like precisely enough for someone else to grade against it

- Clear writing. Tasks must be written by you, not by AI tools

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and data

HOW IT WORKS

1. Apply with your details and CV. After applying, verify your email and choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call. You can book immediately; there is no application-approval step before booking.

2. Attend the walkthrough and enter the code shared by the host at the end of the call to unlock your task workspace.

3. Create one original task from your own work in about 45 minutes. Submit the brief, the actual input files needed to complete it, a written expected result and at least five binary rubric checks, each with one skill tag. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

4. Write the brief and rubric yourself, without AI drafting, rewriting or polishing. Input materials must also be human-authored. Use only materials you are authorised to share, with confidential employer or client information removed.

5. Submit through your account for automated screening and team review. Follow any request for revisions in your account. Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to review.

title: Provider Operations Coordinator
description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth - owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2-3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale - intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Provider Operations Coordinator helps the provider lane run, and is essential for timely and active follow up. The Provider Relations team, including the field provider-relations role and the leaders who hold provider meetings and outreach, own the relationship and are the first point of contact with each provider. This role owns what happens behind that relationship: making sure that once a provider is connected, everything the firm needs from them is requested, received, documented, and entered accurately.

Working like an executive assistant to the provider team, the coordinator sends the firm’s provider materials after a meeting, creates and tracks follow-ups, and works directly with each provider’s admin and front-office staff to collect the remaining information needed on the firm’s side. The coordinator is then responsible for getting that information into the firm’s systems cleanly, so provider records are complete, consistent, and usable by case teams. This person is also the backup for when our relations team is connecting actively with providers to answer the phone and make sure there is quick connection for escalating needs or providers hoping for connection, and help with coordinating in-field adjustments if our in-field representative is in a meeting already.

This role is administrative and detail-driven by design. It frees the provider team to spend its time in the field building relationships, while ensuring no provider falls through the cracks between the first conversation and a complete, usable provider file.

What You Will Own

Provider Follow-Up and Admin Outreach

• Support the Provider Relations team after each provider meeting or outreach contact by sending the firm’s one-pager and related provider materials and drafting and sending the follow-up.

• Create and maintain a follow-up cadence for every newly connected provider, so open items, next steps, and owners are always visible to the team.

• Serve as the day-to-day administrative contact with provider admin and front-office teams, requesting and chasing the remaining information the firm needs on its side.

• Escalate relationship, pricing, or policy questions back to the Provider Relations team rather than handling them directly; keep the provider’s relationship owner informed of anything outstanding.

Provider Data Collection and Documentation

• Track what has been received and what is still missing for each provider. For example, contact and office information, billing and records-request details, locations, and specialties, and follow up until the file is complete.

• Enter and update provider information in the firm’s systems (e.g., Filevine and the provider tracking tool) accurately and on a consistent timeline.

• Support clean provider mapping so each provider and location is recorded once, consistently, and linked correctly to the cases and records that reference

📍 On-Site | Aerospace Manufacturing 💰 $28-$34/hour, depending on experience 🕐 Full-Time | Flexible Hours 🌟 Benefits Available
About the Role
A locally owned Aerospace Manufacturing Company is looking for an experienced Manufacturing Auditor to join our Engineering/Manufacturing team.
This is a hands-on quality role focused on ensuring manufacturing processes, inspection practices, and documentation meet customer and company standards. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical inspection experience, excellent GD&T and blueprint reading skills, and the confidence to work directly with machinists, supervisors, engineering, and management.
What You'll Do
Perform in-process and floor audits at CNC machines and throughout the manufacturing area.
Verify machinists are using the correct blueprint revisions, tooling, CNC programs, and Net-Inspect information.
Review parts and dimensions using precision inspection equipment.
Verify inspection tools and gauges-including micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, thread gauges, dial indicators, air gauges, and CNC probes-are properly calibrated and used.
Review SOPs, traveler routing sheets, and manufacturing processes for compliance.
Investigate first-article and inspection discrepancies using available measurement equipment.
Review previous quality issues, scrap information, SPC trends, and Net-Inspect data to identify potential problems.
Monitor 5S, safety, and FOD prevention throughout the manufacturing floor.
Document audit findings and maintain daily audit/shift records.
Participate in root cause analysis and CAPA activities, including the use of 5 Whys.
Communicate quality trends and recurring issues to machinists, programmers, shop foremen, Engineering, and Quality.
Help train employees on proper inspection equipment use and manufacturing principles.
What We're Looking For
Required:
5+ years of mechanical inspection experience
Strong GD&T and complex blueprint reading skills
Experience with precision measurement and inspection equipment
Knowledge of surface plate setup and inspection techniques
Strong understanding of shop math and mechanical principles
Ability to use and interpret SPC and Six Sigma tools
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to remain objective and unbiased when conducting audits
Preferred:
CMM experience
Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or AS9102
Experience with problem-solving and corrective action
CQT or CMI certification
Experience with Net-Inspect
Spanish language skills
The Right Person Will Be
🔍 Analytical - able to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and determine root causes. 🤝 People-Oriented - comfortable working with employees at all levels while maintaining professionalism and tact. 🎯 Objective - able to conduct unbiased audits and focus on company and customer requirements. 🛠️ Hands-On - confident using inspection equipment and investigating manufacturing issues. 📣 A Strong Communicator - able to clearly explain findings, provide feedback, and help employees improve.
Work Environment
This position works in a machine shop/manufacturing environment with exposure to manufacturing equipment and noise. The role involves standing, walking, leaning, and occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs.
Drug-Free & Smoke-Free Workplace
If you're an experienced quality/inspection professional looking for a hands-on role in aerospace manufacturing, we'd love to hear from you!

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

Position Summary

We are hiring a Manufacturing Engineering Lead as our first hire focused on manufacturing rather than R&D. Our robotic turret product is moving from engineering-built units toward repeatable production, and we need someone to plant the seeds of our manufacturing process with a clear eye on how that process will scale.

This is a ground-floor role. Today there is no manufacturing organization; you will define its foundations. That starts with the manufacturing strategy itself: what we build in-house in Austin, what we place with contract manufacturers and suppliers, and how that split evolves as volume grows. The processes, documentation, quality practices, and supplier relationships you establish in year one are what the production org will be built on, and for the right person there is real potential to grow into leading that organization as it takes shape.

This is also a hands-on role in the most literal sense. The first manufacturing instructions will be written by you, from builds you perform yourself, bolt by bolt. We are looking for someone who has done this before: someone who has taken hardware from prototype into production at least once and can describe concretely what that transition looked like, the role they personally played in it, and what they would do differently this time.

Essential Duties

- Define the manufacturing strategy. Own the make/buy analysis for the product. Decide what we build and assemble in-house versus what we source from suppliers and contract manufacturers and build the roadmap for how those split changes with volume.

- Build early units yourself and write the first MIs. Turn the bolts with your own hands-on early builds, and capture what you learn as the manufacturing instructions, travelers, fixtures, and process documentation the production line will inherit.

- Stand up the production process. Establish routings, assembly and test stations, tooling and fixtures, and the flow of material through the building. Start lean, but structure it so it scales instead of being thrown away at 10x volume.

- Drive design for manufacturability. Partner with mechanical, electrical, and firmware engineering while designs are still fluid. Push DFM/DFA, tolerance and process-capability thinking, and part-count reduction into the product before it hardens.

- Qualify and manage suppliers. Select machine shops, fabricators, and contract manufacturers. Own first-article inspection, supplier corrective action, and the working relationships that keep parts arriving on spec and on time.

- Lay the quality foundation. Build right-sized quality practices from scratch: incoming inspection, in-process checks, end-of-line test, nonconformance and corrective action, and unit-level serialization and traceability appropriate to NFA-regulated manufacturing.

description:

We’re seeking an exceptional Test Engineer to join our Germany-based team focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Test Engineer, you'll independently own the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack. You'll build robust, reusable test automation, drive failures to root cause across engineering boundaries, and steadily raise the bar on coverage, reliability, and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system including sensing and model-behaviour testing as the company and your experience evolve. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement across multiple engineering domains.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration, and system levels, across software and hardware boundaries.

- Automate open-loop and closed-loop replay based Tests, reliability and fault-injection tests to support verification, release, coverage expansion, and debug workflows.

- Lead root-cause investigations for failures found during test campaigns, collaborating across hardware, software, and infrastructure teams.

- Optimise buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable, and repeatable execution.

- Integrate third-party verification tools including JAMA (requirements), MC/DC (coverage), and MISRA (style compliance); manage artefacts via Artifactory and Azure.

- Define and track KPIs and quality metrics for system testing, supporting data-driven validation and release decisions.

- Uncover software and hardware bugs through increased test coverage and report findings through JIRA.

- Identify and implement infrastructure improvements that enhance test coverage, failure traceability, and compliance reporting.

- Review, create, and adhere to Risk Assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

 

🙌 You should apply if

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software, or mechatronic systems, with a track record of delivering test automation independently.

- Experience with L2+ hands-off, L3, or L4 automated driving systems.

- Knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols (e.g., Euro NCAP -AEB, LSS/LKA, ADAS scenarios), DCAS regulatory testing (UN R171), and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155).

- Experience with HiL testing and tooling using CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, dSPACE, Vector, Xylon, or similar.

- Strong proficiency in Python, including developing automation test frameworks with pytest.

- Proven ability in interface-level testing, including hardware/software interactions and embedded interfaces.

- Experience integrating software quality assurance tools and standards (ASPICE, SOTIF, ISO 26262, JAMA, X-RAY).

- Knowledge of open- and closed-loop HiL replay using dSPACE or other emulators.

- Proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling (e.g., GitLab CI, Buildkite, Bazel).

- Experience with test automation dashboards, logging, and reporting infrastructure (e.g., Grafana, Looker, Datadog, JIRA).

- Experience developing or testing automotive software across embedded and system levels.

- Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work collaboratively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps, and product teams.

title: Concept Artist / Illustrator
description:
We are looking for a creative and passionate individual to join our team as a volunteer 2D Concept Artist!
In this volunteer position, you will be asked to create a variety of high-quality concept art and/or illustrative work for The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order (LoA:SO). Interested applicants must be advised that this is a long-term volunteer project, and as such, you must be ready to contribute to the game on a long-term basis (however, as this is an unpaid position, full-time dedication is not expected). A variety of different concept types, such as characters, creatures, landscape, architecture, etc, may be required. For illustrative work, you may be asked to create illustrations that will be used as in-game paintings (and should replicate various medieval painting styles).
Concept Art and Illustration should be created in a timely manner on demand; while there is no set amount of time that a team member should put into the project, it is expected for each work to be handled within a reasonable timeframe. Multiple applicants may be accepted; this job is not for a single position.

Communication is key to a smooth and efficient working pipeline. Therefore, the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with other team members is essential. It is also important to not afraid to ask and discuss, and find out the solution should any problems arise. We are an English-speaking team, so proficiency in the English language is a must.
What you’ll be doing:

• Partner with the Art Director and other team members to pioneer the vision of the game.

• Design, create, and develop high-quality sketches and quick iterations digitally (you can do it on paper but the finished artwork must be digital).

• Create and develop original concepts of characters, environment, and props based on references or from scratch.

• Attend weekly meetings with the whole team on Slack (instant messaging software we use for communication).

• Present concepts and ideas to the team for further discussion.

• Creatively problem-solve and figure out efficient solutions to executing the look and feel of the character and environment.

• Achieve a balance between artistic aspects and technical constraints.

• Adjust the artwork styles to meet the game’s art direction.

• Set your own reasonable deadlines, and make sure the work is done on time.

Minimum Requirements:

• Working knowledge of design and drawing programs such as photoshop, illustrator, procreate, or your program of choice.

• Excellent understanding of art fundamentals: lighting, composition, architecture, human anatomy, etc.

• Ability to create high-quality concept art and illustrations of characters, creatures, environments, architecture, and more.

• Ability to give and take feedback professionally and applies it to the art and design.

• Flexibility and adaptive capabilities. Able to collaborate and work as a part of the team.

• Fluency in English is a must.

Recommended Requirements:

• Experience in game design or game developing industry.

• Shipped 1 or more video game titles.

• Educational background in art, design, or other related fields

• Experience in Unreal Engine 5

description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Green Bay
Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health, dental and vision insurance

• Paid time off

• Annual CEU allowance

• 401K

• Supplies and other perks

• Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Software Engineer, Robotics
description: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. What you'll do Architect the robot operating system. Design the core abstractions: how robots, cameras, tools and jobs are modelled, how work is planned and dispatched, how state is shared and how failures are handled. Decide what belongs in Python and what needs Rust. Bring in new vision. Integrate novel computer vision algorithms into the control loop, from finding and centring parts to checking every pick and placement, and make them fast and reliable enough for production. Build agentic robotics. Put large models to work in the robots themselves: programming a new part from its datasheet, judging a pick from a camera image, diagnosing a fault and recovering from it, with evals that prove it works before it runs alone. Move a fleet. Route dozens of movers at once without collisions or deadlocks, and coordinate gantries, printers and ovens around them.

title: Staff Software engineer - Network infrastructure - APAC
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role
We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer to build software that makes network operations safe, scalable, and boring, as we launch new data centers in APAC and expand fast. This is not a "write scripts for configs" role: you'll build the tooling and services that sit between the network core (switches/ports/VLANs, traffic processors) and the cloud platform on top, using open source where it fits and building the missing pieces where it doesn't. At this stage of our APAC growth you will be hands-on: writing code, making architectural decisions and owning your area end to end, with real autonomy. Then you will grow the local engineering team around you.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Build and maintain services and tooling that automate the network lifecycle: day-0 provisioning, day-N changes, drift detection, and operational verification

• Make network changes safe and transparent: CI/CD workflows, diff/review tooling, staged rollouts/rollbacks, audit trails, and guardrails

• Develop observability systems that scale across many sites: telemetry pipelines, signal quality, and tooling that shortens incident investigations

• Close "last mile" gaps between the network and the platform: integrate source-of-truth data, expose APIs, and build reliable automation around it

• Own architecture and technical decisions for your area in APAC, and align them with the European teams

• Collaborate closely with network engineers and SREs to turn real operational pain into product-quality tooling

• Hire and onboard the first engineers in the region, set code quality and engineering standards, and mentor the team

We expect you to have:

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent practical background), including experience as a tech lead or team lead with broad ownership

• Strong coding skills and ownership mindset: you can ship and operate reliable services

• Proficiency in Go or readiness to switch; Python is also welcome (other languages can be useful for OSS debugging/fixes)

• Ability to work autonomously in an early-stage environment, make decisions with incomplete information, and build processes from scratch

• Willingness to stay hands-on while leading and growing a team

title: Software Engineer, Payments Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The agent must collect and use a card number but can never see it. This work sits across four hard technical domains: payments, security, real-time voice, and LLMs. Voice is the core challenge. A caller speaks or types a card number in a live, low-latency audio stream, and the digits must never reach the model, while the model stays on the call.

Sierra owns every system that touches card data, and one small team owns it end to end across three workstreams: Platform, Product, and Safety & Integrity. Customers keep their own telephony and payment gateways. Payments is live in production for some of the largest consumer enterprises, on a platform that handles hundreds of millions of calls a year. The platform is certified to PCI DSS Level 1.

- Build real-time card capture for voice: intercept keypad and spoken digits in a live audio stream, upstream of the agent runtime in a network-segmented environment, while the LLM stays live on the call. Make it work across every telephony provider and protocol Sierra supports.

- Build and extend the tokenization platform: agents receive and send short-lived tokens, and the platform swaps a token for the real value only when it calls the customer's payment gateway.

- Own the payments egress control plane: every destination for card data is approved, versioned with the agent release, and enforced by infrastructure below the application, not by convention.

- Make payment actions correct: an at-most-once action primitive in the Agent SDK, validated amounts and items, and monitoring that compares what the agent said about a payment with what really happened.

- Keep card data out of places it should not be: deterministic detection in the agent's hot path that catches what general-purpose models miss. No LLM, including any we build ourselves, ever sees a plaintext card number.

- Make payments self-serve: one payments API across Agent Studio, the Agent SDK, and Ghostwriter, Sierra's agent-building agent; gateway middleware that developers write against tokens; and support for single-tenant and customer-cloud deployments. Any team can add payments to an agent without a payments engineer in the loop.

- Grow the platform beyond cards: extend tokenization into a privacy vault for all PII.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years building backend, platform, or infrastructure systems, with a track record of shipping and operating high-reliability services in production.

- A deep security instinct. You design as though every component will eventually be compromised, and you reason naturally about blast radius, least privilege, and making bad states impossible rather than reacting to them.

- Rigor abo

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Evaluate de-identified medical images across multiple modalities
